title: Provider parsing and terminal results fabricate success from incomplete or invalid output
wanted_capability: Strict tool argument decoding, terminal stream validation, schema-valid final results and typed incomplete outcomes
missing_primitive: Strict tool argument decoding, terminal stream validation, schema-valid final results and typed incomplete outcomes
fallback_used: Isolated synthetic probes and explicit raw tool use; no shared service changes during audit.
notes: Synthetic full Chat harness accepts unterminated SSE as success and accepts boolean final_result for integer schema; live turn exhaustion reports prior narration as success.
resolution_note: Repaired on beta in the provider/result integrity milestone: strict object arguments across provider and nested admission, explicit terminal streams, schema-valid single final_result, and distinct incomplete outcomes. All 16 executable boundary cases pass; baseline passed only the two valid controls. See design/bro-harness/model-facing-audit/result-integrity-repair.md and result-integrity-repair-receipts.json.
